prompt: I need a recipe for a dish that contains the following ingredients: 4 eggs, 2 large potatoes, 2 spanish onions, olive oil, salt and pepper
response: This recipe will make a delicious Spanish omelette. Peel and slice the potatoes and onions. Fry them in olive oil until soft, then set aside. Beat the eggs with salt and pepper. Pour the eggs into the pan and cook until set, folding the omelette in half before serving.
